subject: Kickoff: MAP stitch & template proposal — initial GDoc shared
content:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Peter Cho <peter@acme.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: MAP stitch & template proposal — initial GDoc shared

Hi Peter + Acme team,

Nice to meet you over email — thanks again for the demo yesterday. To make the evaluation and close predictable, I pulled together a lightweight mutual action plan (MAP) template and an initial draft Google Doc we can iterate on during a short working session. The goal: a 30–45 minute working session where we agree on stakeholders, acceptance criteria, and a realistic path to a pilot sign-off.

What I attached / shared:
- MAP_Template_v1.xlsx (starter MAP with milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria columns)
- Initial GDoc (link below) with suggested timelines and sandbox steps pre-filled

Proposed next steps:
1) Can we lock a 30-min working session this week to co-edit the GDoc?
2) We'll capture procurement requirements (DocuSign, SOW cadence) and security checklist items during the session.
3) Post-session: Redwood will convert the GDoc to a single-page MAP and share final timelines.

Suggested times (PT): Wed 12/9 10:00–10:30, Wed 12/9 15:00–15:30, Thu 12/10 09:00–09:30. If none work, send a couple windows and we'll accommodate.

GDoc (initial draft): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDeFGhijk_MAP-initial-draft

Attachments: MAP_Template_v1.xlsx (Excel)

Thanks — looking forward to the co-edit.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Peter Cho <peter@acme.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 13:22:49 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP stitch & template proposal — initial GDoc shared

Great kickoff note — I pulled together a short slide outline and populated the MAP template with a proposed 6-week pilot timeline and acceptance criteria. See attachment: MAP_Outline_Slides.pptx (2 slides). Key assumptions I put in the draft:
- Pilot scope: 1 production feature (chat responses) + one internal eval metric set
- Acceptance criteria: latency < 300ms p95 for 1k qps baseline; regeneration quality measured by weighted BLEU/qual test set; no PII exfiltration in 3 runs
- Owners: Acme SRE (infra), Acme PM (product), Redwood CS (onboarding), Redwood Eng (sandbox)

I've also added a "security artifacts" column per Peter's ask with placeholders for SOC 2 and data retention.

If we lock 12/9 15:00 PT, I can run through the timeline and we can co-edit the GDoc live.

Attachments: MAP_Outline_Slides.pptx (PowerPoint)

—Marissa
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
---
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Peter Cho <peter@acme.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 09:40:10 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP stitch & template proposal — initial GDoc shared

Adding a couple technical notes so the MAP reflects minimal sandbox access steps: 
- Week 0: Redwood provides a pre-configured VPC sandbox + test keys (rolling 7-day keys).
- Week 1: Ingestion pipeline runbook (sample data redaction steps) — attach runbook to GDoc.
- Week 2: Baseline perf run and KV cache checks; we'll capture p95 latencies and token counts.

Also proposing an alternate close timeline if procurement cycles are long: a two-phase close where we start with a low-risk PoC (30 days) followed by an enterprise pilot once procurement signs the SOW. I added that as an appendix in the GDoc.

Dev
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Peter Cho <peter@acme.ai>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP stitch & template proposal — initial GDoc shared

Thanks all — Wed 12/9 15:00 PT worked well; appreciate the quick sync. Notes and outcomes from the co-edit: 
- We agreed on a 6-week pilot timeline by default with an alternate 30-day PoC path if procurement is slow.
- Action items assigned in the GDoc: procurement to confirm payment terms (Acme), Acme SRE to provide initial test dataset, Redwood to provide the VPC sandbox and onboarding runbook.
- Security artifacts column: Marissa populated SOC 2 attestation and data retention notes; Acme to confirm any additional evidence they need.

Updated items & how to proceed: 
- Updated MAP: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDeFGhijk_MAP-initial-draft (read-only for now; I'll turn on edit for Acme procurement after they confirm email)
- Meeting scheduled: Fri, 12/11 10:00–10:30 PT (calendar invite link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=acme-map-workshop-20261211)
- Next deliverable: final single-page MAP and a slide two-pager by Tue 12/15.

Attachments (referenced): MAP_Template_v1.xlsx, MAP_Outline_Slides.pptx

Peter / procurement — can you confirm the procurement contact (name + direct email) we should give edit access to the GDoc? Once we have that, we'll enable edit and add DocuSign SOW template in the "Procurement" appendix.

Thanks — ready to get the SOW template in place and push this to pilot.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
